description: This file defines the 'Manufacturer' entity class used in the business catalog product model for representing manufacturer data, including descriptions, images, and relationships with merchant stores.

classes.name: Manufacturer
classes.description: Entity class representing a manufacturer, with fields for ID, description set, image, order, and relationship to MerchantStore, along with auditing functionality.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the manufacturer.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the manufacturer.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Retrieves the audit information associated with this entity.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit information for this entity.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Gets the image URL or path associated with the manufacturer.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the image URL or path for the manufacturer.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the set of manufacturer descriptions.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the collection of manufacturer descriptions.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with the manufacturer.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with the manufacturer.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves the sort order of the manufacturer.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order for the manufacturer.
